# Flush Event Queue

![Flush Event Queue function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/dialog/events/04-flush-event-queue.svg)

[DialogUserInterface functions](../../dialoguserinterface/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Atomically removes eligible pending notifications while retaining the subscription. Returns the registration and a u32 removal count, never the removed payloads. Stops before a filter event. Time and keep-most-recent protections accumulate; the retained quantity is global across targeted queues. Unwired options differ from explicit zero. Static-queue inclusion requires the actual enclosing Event case and defaults according to that context. Ordinary Queue&lt;T&gt; references are incompatible.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Flush Event Queue**

Retire atomiquement les notifications admissibles en conservant l'inscription. Retourne l'inscription et un compteur u32, jamais les messages supprimés. S'arrête avant un événement filtre. Les protections temporelle et keep most recent se cumulent ; la quantité conservée est globale aux files ciblées. Une option non câblée diffère d'un zéro explicite. L'inclusion de la file statique exige le véritable cas Event englobant et son défaut dépend de ce contexte. Une Queue&lt;T&gt; ordinaire est incompatible.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Atomically discard eligible old notifications before the first filter. Time and global retained-count protections combine. Unwired options differ from explicit zero. Registration omission and wired static inclusion require actual Event-case membership. FROG also accepts stable event-kind strings as selection criteria.
